Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity flat screenshot mockup of Postie, a lightweight Swift-native macOS HTTP API client for personal use. Landscape 1600 by 1050 composition. Native light macOS appearance: subtle warm gray toolbar with traffic lights, SF Pro-like typography, SF Mono code, thin separators, restrained blue accent, small native controls, no web dashboard styling, no marketing, no perspective, no decorative desktop. Clean plausible desktop app, legible text, dense usable layout with generous breathing room. This is screen 1: request editor and response.
Shared sidebar 220px: toolbar title Postie; navigation 'Requests' selected, 'Ongoing Requests' with blue badge 2, 'Snapshots', 'Global Variables'; Collections section: Shop API expanded with GET List orders, POST Create order selected; Reports expanded with POST Generate report spinner and GET Download export spinner. Flat collection hierarchy only, no nested folders. Small plus button at sidebar bottom.
Main area: breadcrumb Shop API / Create order, top right Copy cURL. Horizontal request row POST dropdown, URL '{{base_url}}/orders', blue Send button. Follow redirects checkbox. Request tabs Query, Headers, Body, Auth, Variables. Body selected; JSON editor with muted line numbers and syntax highlighting, example {"product": "widget", "status": "{{status}}", "quantity": 2}; variable token distinct purple. Small resolved variable helper 'status → open · Collection'. Horizontal split response lower pane with green '201 Created', '143 ms', '1.2 KB', button Save Snapshot. Response tabs Body, Headers, Redirects (2); Body selected, Pretty JSON / Raw segmented control. JSON response {"id": 42, "status": "open", "total": 129.50} with syntax highlighting. No real credentials, names/emails, arbitrary charts, teams, billing, cloud or environment selector. This is a design concept, not a website. Large sharp native UI at readable scale.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity flat screenshot mockup of Postie lightweight native macOS API client, landscape 1600 by 1050. No real personal information or tokens. Flat screenshot only, no device mockup, no giant headings.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity flat screenshot of Postie, a lightweight Swift-native macOS HTTP client. Selected request 'List orders'. Main top: Shop API / List orders; GET '{{base_url}}/legacy/orders', blue Send, checked 'Follow redirects'. Compact request tabs Headers, Body, Auth, Variables and a minimal request header table, then response divider with '200 OK · 312 ms · 1.2 KB' and Save Snapshot button.
Response tabs Body, Headers, Redirects (2), Redirects selected. Three accordion/disclosure sections with chevrons: first COLLAPSED '302 Found   GET /legacy/orders'; second EXPANDED '301 Moved Permanently   GET /v1/orders'; third COLLAPSED '200 OK   GET /v2/orders'.
